summary: Feed s177_triple is degraded: 7.4% duplicates, 5.1% TCP packet drops/gaps, and 16.51 Gbps microbursts overloading the 10 Gbps NDR port (165% capacity). Deduplication and load-balancing at the packet broker are required to restore complete traffic to the NDR.

findings.root_cause: Duplicate packets from overlapping SPAN/TAP aggregation without broker deduplication. 632 of 8555 packets (7.4%) exceed 5% threshold, typical when same traffic is fed from multiple SPANs or both sides of a TAP without dedup window.
findings.impact_on_tool: Wastes NDR processing and 10G bandwidth, inflates flow counts and skews NDR analytics/correlation, can cause false-positive detections and reduces effective detection capacity.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication (packet-hash window ~10ms) before the NDR to strip duplicates while preserving one copy of each flow for full detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: Broker/tool buffer drops causing TCP gaps - 430 of 8507 TCP packets (5.1%) show missing data. Correlates directly with tool overload bursts to 16.51 Gbps on a 10 Gbps port, indicating drops at broker egress/tool ingress due to oversubscription, not just SPAN.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR cannot reassemble TCP streams and misses payload - breaks signature matching, file extraction, and behavioral detection. NDR needs_full_payload=true and needs_both_directions=true, so any gap creates blind spots.

recommended_fix.why: Load-balance the feed across 2x10G NDR ports (5-tuple hashing to keep flows intact) to absorb 16.5 Gbps bursts and eliminate buffer drops; same fix resolves tool_overload.

findings.root_cause: Single 10 Gbps NDR port is oversubscribed by aggregated feed. Measured peak 16.51 Gbps in 1ms burst = 165% of port capacity (threshold 80%), with 2 overloaded intervals. No load-balancing or rate-shaping at broker.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR ingress drops during bursts, exactly matching the 5.1% TCP gaps observed. Results in systematic missed detections during peak traffic - NDR is blind when it is most needed.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute s177_triple across multiple NDR tool ports via broker load-balancing (or add 10G capacity / 2-port LAG) with 5-tuple flow affinity to keep both directions together and keep peak utilization <80%.
